freeze_batch_norm_2d: freeze all BatchNorm2d and SyncBatchNorm layers in a PyTorch module by converting them to FrozenBatchNorm2d
freeze_batch_norm_2d_selective: freeze only specific named BatchNorm2d layers in a PyTorch module using a module_match dictionary
to_2tuple: convert a single integer or iterable into a 2-tuple for use as kernel size or stride
to_4tuple: convert a single integer or iterable into a 4-tuple for use as padding or margin
to_ntuple: dynamically convert a single integer or iterable into an n-tuple of any specified length
